newsitem.title: UK: Amey buys rest of railways unit.
newsitem.headline: Amey buys rest of railways unit.

text.p: British capital projects developer Amey Plc said on Tuesday it had bought the remaining 25 percent stake of its majority-owned Amey Railways unit for about 3.48 million stg cash.
Amey bought the minority stake from the unit's management.
Amey's shares firmed 5.0p to 392 by 0720 GMT.
The company said the unit's order book stood at record levels following the recent award of some 35 million stg of new contracts.

As part of the deal, Peter Forbes resigned as deputy chairman of Amey Railways and as a director of Amey, although he planned to serve as a consultant until December 1999. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
